charge_port.notes: Canadian review of the 2026 EX30 says CCS1 charge port.

Estimated: The Charge Port 2026 US checker lists the Volvo EX30 (2025-2026) as CCS1 with an adapter; InsideEVs says early US units use CCS1. For Canada the same car is sold and Volvo Canada promised a NACS adapter (Cision release), which implies CCS1; Motor Illustrated (Canadian review) also says CCS1.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated, OWNER FLAG: US: The Charge Port 2026 checker (search excerpt) lists EX30 as CCS1 with a paid adapter, and a Volvo US support excerpt lists the EX30 among cars that can use Superchargers. Canada: the only Canadian page found (Volvo Canada release, Cision, Oct 2024) says EX30 adapter availability will be announced later; no later Canadian announcement found in repeated searches. Canadian access is therefore an inference from the identical US car.
